meta.name: content-gap-analysis
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "find content gaps", "竞品写了什么", or "还应该写什么"; builds a competitor-relative coverage map of missing topics, keyword gaps, and editorial-calendar opportunities. Not for raw keyword demand discovery — use keyword-research. 内容缺口/选题规划

copy.tagline: 发现竞品已写而你未覆盖的内容选题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责内容策略，想通过竞品分析找到缺失的选题机会。
copy.tagline_en: Discover content topics your competitors cover but you don't
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own content strategy and want to find untapped topics by analyzing competitors.

howto.what: 分析你的网站与竞争对手的内容差距，找出你缺少的主题、关键词和内容类型，并按优先级排序，生成行动计划和内容日历。
howto.when: 当你要求“找内容差距”、“竞品写了什么”或“还应该写什么”时触发。需要提供你的域名和竞争对手域名。

say.text: 找一下我的网站和主要竞争对手的内容差距。
我最近三个月没写的内容，竞争对手写了哪些？
对比我的博客和竞品，找出缺失的选题。

howto.what_en: Analyzes content gaps between your site and competitors, identifying missing topics, keywords, and content types, then prioritizes them and generates an action plan with a content calendar.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to "find content gaps", "竞品写了什么", or "还应该写什么". Requires your domain and competitor domains.

say_en.text: Find content gaps between my site and top competitors.
What content have competitors published in the last 3 months that I haven't?
Compare my blog vs competitors and find missing topics.
